tagline: Create safe stored calculated fields without custom Python code
problem: Businesses need calculated values on records without maintaining custom modules for each formula.
solution: Formula Fields provides a restricted expression engine and synchronises formulas as Odoo computed fields.

features.title: Safe formulas
features.text: Only approved operators and functions are evaluated.

features.title: Dynamic fields
features.text: Formulas synchronise to native Odoo computed fields.

features.title: Templates
features.text: Start from common margin, profit, remaining, tax, and VIP formulas.
